headline: Board Of Trustees Names Interim Leader In Fountain Of Life Crisis
seoTitle: Fountain of Life Church Leadership Dispute
metaDescription: The Fountain of Life Church board has appointed an interim leader after removing Jimmy Odukoya, citing a newly released succession video.
aiSummaryBullets: The Fountain of Life Church Board of Trustees officially removed Jimmy Odukoya from his position as senior pastor.
Trustees released a video featuring the late founder, Taiwo Odukoya, identifying Kunle Areogun as the intended successor.
Church leadership has alleged the unauthorized takeover of social media channels during the ongoing internal transition.
aiContextParagraph: The Fountain of Life Church in Lagos is currently experiencing an internal governance crisis following the formal removal of Jimmy Odukoya from his role as senior pastor. The decision, initiated by the church's Board of Trustees, has been met with resistance from Jimmy Odukoya and segments of the congregation who contest the validity of the board's actions. To substantiate their position, the trustees released a recorded video featuring the late founder, Taiwo Odukoya, in which he designates Pastor Kunle Areogun as his chosen successor. In addition to the leadership transition, the board reported that the church's social media platforms were seized by external parties. This development follows a period of public uncertainty and mixed reactions regarding the stability of the institution's leadership structure, with both the board and the ousted pastor issuing conflicting statements about the legitimacy of the removal process.
whyItIsViral: The event is gaining attention following coverage from two independent media outlets and a moderate pace of reporting regarding the high-profile leadership dispute.
